title: Improving Gohr’s Neural Distinguisher Accuracy
summary: A neural distinguisher can separate real and random ciphertext-pair sets sharing the same differential distribution, but whether alternative settings improve accuracy remains open.

formal_statement.body: Determine whether alternative settings can improve the accuracy of Gohr's neural distinguishers.

scope.domain: Machine-learning-based symmetric cryptanalysis using Gohr’s neural distinguishers.
parameters: Alternative settings — candidate choices whose effect on accuracy is to be evaluated
scope.unresolved_remainder: Whether any alternative settings can improve the accuracy of Gohr’s neural distinguishers.

citations.label: A Deeper Look at Machine Learning-Based Cryptanalysis

progress.summary: The source presents this as a final natural question after observing that a neural distinguisher can separate real and random sets with the same differential distribution. It asks whether better settings could improve Gohr’s distinguishers.
citation_labels: Adrien Benamira et al., A Deeper Look at Machine Learning-Based Cryptanalysis
